newsitem.title: USA: Ark Restaurants sees Q4 gains over yr-ago.
newsitem.headline: Ark Restaurants sees Q4 gains over yr-ago.

text.p: Ark Restaurants Corp said Wednesday it expects to report fourth fiscal quarter results "well in excess of the prior year's results."

In the fourth quarter that ended September 28, 1996, the company reported a net income of $655,000 or $0.20 per share, on net sales of $20.022 million. The quarter's results included a $0.04-a-share charge.

Michael Weinstein, president of the restaurant chain, issued the forecast as the company reported that net sales for its third fiscal quarter ended June 29 rose to $31.47 million, up from $22.6 million for the quarter a year ago.
Net income for the latest quarter was $1,948,000, or $.51 per share, compared with $1,138,000, or $.35 per share, in the prior year's quarter.
Weinstein said that in the latest quarter, the company achieved strong operating results despite a slight decrease in comparative same-store sales.
The decrease in the first half of the quarter was due to unseasonably cold weather, which prevented it from utilizing outdoor seating capacity, he said.
